name: Twinkle Park Playground
description: Twinkle Park is one of Royal Greenwich's Green Flag Community Award-winning sites, jointly awarded with Charlotte Turner Gardens. An unusual park with a large pond, wildlife gardens, gazebo and a mosaic floor compass made by Greenwich Mural Workshop.
